## Checklist

- [ ] `go vet ./...`, `go test -race ./...` and `node --test tests/*.test.mjs` pass
- [ ] Version and notes in `semver.txt` updated, and the image tag in `compose.yaml` matches
- [ ] Feature files in `features/` cover the changed behavior
- [ ] UI changes checked in English and German, including accessible names
- [ ] Docs (README, SECURITY, CONTRIBUTING) updated if behavior or settings changed
